title: Calangute Beach
description: A broad sandy shore with nearby galleries and shops for a varied coastal day.

title: Baga Beach
description: Calangute's coastal neighbour, known for its lively beach scene and nightlife nearby.

title: Candolim Beach
description: A North Goa shoreline suited to a relaxed beach stop and coastal exploration.

title: Anjuna Beach
description: An evolving coastal neighbourhood whose beach and market heritage draw curious visitors.

title: Vagator Beach
description: A rocky coastline below cliffs, with shore views and room for an unhurried walk.

title: Morjim Beach
description: A coastal stretch associated with seasonal Olive Ridley nesting; respect protected areas.

title: Mandrem Beach
description: A quieter northern shore associated with long walks, yoga and restful beach days.

title: Palolem Beach
description: A sandy bay framed by headlands in Canacona, with fishing and beachside village life.

title: Colva Beach
description: A well-connected South Goa beach near Margao, with shops around its central approach.

title: Agonda Beach
description: A far-southern beach suggested by Goa Tourism for exploring the Canacona coast.

title: Basilica of Bom Jesus
description: An Old Goa heritage church housing the relics of Saint Francis Xavier.

title: Se Cathedral
description: A major church in Old Goa's historic monument precinct, suited to a heritage walk.

title: Church and Convent of St Francis of Assisi
description: Include this historic church and convent in a self-guided exploration of Old Goa.

title: Viceroy's Arch
description: A stone gateway by Old Goa's former river entrance, with historical carved details.

title: Divar Island
description: A river-island landscape of winding village roads and greenery across from Old Goa.

title: Archaeological Museum, Old Goa
description: A museum within the heritage precinct, introducing visitors to Goa's past through displays.
